_comment: Declarative AutoForm layout for Burst Background Estimation: a persistent dock area with the detector channel-definition page, the TTTR file list + Estimate action, the tail-fit settings (sliders over the fit window, which is the one judgement call in the estimate, coupled to the draggable band on the inter-photon-time plot), the inter-photon-time distribution (points + fitted tail), the per-detector background-rate bars and the results table — each a draggable chisurf dock. The Channel Definition and Files docks are dropped when a workflow supplies them (BackgroundViewModel.view_spec).

sections.label: Fit from (ms)
sections.description: Lower edge of the background tail fit, in milliseconds. This is the judgement call in a background estimate: too small and bursts are fitted as background, so the rate comes out too high. Drag the shaded band in the Inter-photon time plot instead if you prefer — it is the same setting.

sections.label: Fit to (ms)
sections.description: Upper edge of the fit. The far tail is bins holding one count each: including it stretches the fit over a decade that carries almost no information and visibly pulls the line off the points. Set it where the points stop being dense.

sections.label: Bin width (ms)
sections.description: Inter-photon-time histogram bin width. Wider bins are smoother and coarser; the fitted rate should not depend on it.

sections.label: Min. counts per bin
sections.description: Bins with fewer counts than this are left out of the tail fit, so the sparse far tail does not dominate it.
